properties_webhook_full_address: The full address is shown after import and on activation. Prefix it with your host when pointing the sender at it.
properties_webhook_set_path: Set the path below — the public URL is minted from it on activation.
properties_credential_needed: This node needs a credential before it can run.
properties_credential_reference_note: The workflow records only the reference. Secrets stay in credential storage.
properties_no_parameters_to_configure: This node has no parameters to configure.
properties_no_settings_to_configure: This node has no shared settings to configure.
properties_expression_hint_default: Resolved per item on the server, for example {example}.
properties_error_invalid_json: This is not valid JSON yet — fix it before saving.
properties_error_options_unavailable: These options could not be loaded.
properties_error_columns_unavailable: These columns could not be loaded.
properties_collection_unreadable: These options were stored as text and cannot be read back as settings. Add them again, or clear the field.
properties_stranded_option: {key} is set but does not apply to this operation.
properties_no_applicable_options: No options apply to this operation.
properties_unknown_mode: This editor does not know the mode “{mode}”. Its value is {value} and cannot be edited here.
properties_unknown_mode_empty: This editor does not know the mode “{mode}”. Its value is empty and cannot be edited here.
properties_automap_summary: Incoming fields are matched to these columns by name: {columns}. A field with no matching column is not sent.
properties_automap_summary_none: Incoming fields are matched to these columns by name: none. A field with no matching column is not sent.
properties_columns_not_loaded: The columns have not loaded yet.
properties_unknown_column_type: This editor does not know the column type “{type}”, so it is edited as text.
properties_unknown_field_type: This editor does not know the field type “{kind}”. Its value is shown as JSON and cannot be edited here.
